cards.effect_text_ja: ◇５以下のパルを１枚選び、墓地に置く。
cards.flavor_text: Fires condensed darkness to pierce its foes.

cards.name: Black Marketeer
cards.japanese_name: 闇商人
cards.effect_text: Choose up to 2 Pals without 〈Interrupt〉 from your graveyard, and return them to hand. It becomes night until the end of the opponent's next turn.
cards.effect_text_ja: あなたの墓地の〈妨害〉を持たないパルを２枚まで選び、手札に戻す。次の相手のターン終了時まで、夜になる。
cards.flavor_text: Apparently hates hanging traps and campfires.

cards.name: Elphidran – Gentle Radiance
cards.japanese_name: 優しい輝き – シルフィア
cards.effect_text: AUTO OnAttack You may reveal 1 card from your hand. If you revealed a Dragon Pal this way, this card gets Power +500 until end of turn.
cards.effect_text_ja: 【自】【アタック時】あなたの手札の【竜】のパルを１枚公開してもよい。公開したら、ターン終了時まで、このカードの【戦闘力】＋500。
cards.flavor_text: Pure of heart, the sacred dragon extends a warm and tender glow.

cards.name: Direhowl – Proud Fang
cards.japanese_name: 誇り高き牙 – ガウルフ
cards.flavor_text: Long ago, Direhowls hunted alongside humans.

cards.name: The Adventure Begins
cards.japanese_name: 冒険の始まり
cards.effect_text:
If you have not played any other cards during this game, draw 2 cards.
If you have 3 or more Pals with 《My First》 in their different card names, choose all of your Pals, and they get Power +1000/Strike +5 until end of turn.
cards.effect_text_ja:
あなたがこのゲーム中、他のカードをプレイしていないなら、２枚引く。
あなたの、カード名に《始まりの》を含む異なるカード名のパルが３種類以上あるなら、あなたのパルをすべて選び、ターン終了時まで、【戦闘力】＋1000/【打撃力】＋５。
cards.flavor_text: "Soon after stepping foot on the island, I discovered a living creature nearby." —Castaway's Journal, Day 1-2
